name: Internationalization & Localization (SDLC Phase 14)
description: Expanding to global markets — aka i18n/L10n, Globalization, Regionalization.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Internationalization & Localization
capabilities.description: Adapts the product's language, formatting, and cultural presentation to operate correctly in new regional markets.

checklists.name: Internationalization & Localization (SDLC Phase 14) Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for internationalization, string extraction, RTL support, and regional compliance.

items.statement: The product has been pseudolocalized and tested to catch layout, truncation, and encoding issues before real translations are applied.
All UI strings are extracted into translatable resource files with zero hardcoded text in components.
Dates, times, currencies, and numbers adapt dynamically to the user's active browser/system locale.
Right-to-Left (RTL) layout mirroring functions correctly without broken alignment or obscured icons.
Regional legal terms and tax requirements are verified for all target launch territories.

reviewGates.name: i18n & Localization Review
reviewGates.statement: The Locale & Language Strategy and localization audits have been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to proceed to Ongoing Operations & Governance.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the product demonstrate full internationalization readiness, accurate translations, and regional compliance for target markets?

obligationDefinitions.title: Localization audit gaps must be closed before Ongoing Operations & Governance
obligationDefinitions.description: Any locale or regional-compliance gap identified in the localization audits must be closed or explicitly accepted per-locale before the product is considered ready for ongoing operations in that locale.
obligationDefinitions.completionCriteria: Every gap in the localization audit is closed or carries a recorded per-locale exception.

requiredEvidence.title: Localization audit closure
requiredEvidence.description: Disposition of each finding in the localization audit, per locale.

obligationDefinitions.prompt: Has every localization audit finding been closed or explicitly exempted for its locale?
